subject: Important Update: New Payment Methods Available
body: Dear valued customers, We are excited to announce that we have recently added new payment methods to make your shopping experience more convenient. You can now pay using PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay at checkout. We hope this enhancement will simplify the payment process for you. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs. Best regards, The Online Store Team
